% Pattern: head/environment. A theorem environment written as a bare
% command, \definition ... \enddefinition, with no \begin and \end, is the
% environment. Seen in the gold pilot (set X).
% want definition-1 definition 1.1
% want theorem-1 statement/theorem 1.2
\documentclass{article}
\newtheorem{definition}{Definition}[section]
\newtheorem{theorem}[definition]{Theorem}
\begin{document}
\section{One}

\definition\label{d:compact}
A space is compact when every open cover has a finite subcover.
\enddefinition

\theorem
Every closed subset of a compact space is compact.
\endtheorem
\end{document}
